acceptance: One source of truth for stream capability, with a test that class and manifest cannot disagree
Maintenance opens sessions through open_stream_connection with benchmark_type
Dead Databricks throughput code is removed or made reachable deliberately
Spark per-stream cache clearing is verified, and either moved outside the timed window or documented
description:
The throughput gate resolves capability from the platform manifest (connection_wrappers.py:194-201), but new_stream_connection dispatches on the class attribute (adapter.py:801). The class attribute is shared_cursor for 34 adapters whose manifest says unsupported.

Dead code: Databricks' _execute_tpch_throughput_test and new_stream_connection override (databricks/adapter.py:2720-2730) cannot run for throughput because its manifest says UNSUPPORTED.

Maintenance calls self.new_stream_connection(connection) without the gate or benchmark_type (execution.py:578,677), so independent maintenance sessions skip configure_for_benchmark tuning.

Spark: with disable_cache=True (the default), every stream calls spark.catalog.clearCache() on the shared session inside the timed window (spark_execution_mixin.py ~547), so streams clear each other's cache. Plausible; not reproduced.
